## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List commands run and results, including any checks that could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes stay focused and follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `pnpm verify:fast` passed; full verification runs in CI/release.
- [ ] Relevant tests use mocked database/IO or explicitly disposable migration targets.
- [ ] Product/access docs and reviewed schema migrations are updated where needed.
- [ ] UI copy uses `t()`; new env vars update schema, manifest and generated examples.
- [ ] Public routes/discovery/sitemap and generated agent docs are updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, private dependency material or personal data are included.
- [ ] Third-party attribution is preserved.
